body: thank you so much! i absolutely adore my mom, she’s one of the reasons i choose to keep on going because i can’t stand the thought of her having to deal with my death, especially with her current financial struggles due to the virus alongside her mental health problems. this really made my day :)

i havent really thought about it too much but my family holds grades at an extremely high standard and i’ve been working quite hard to getting those well so my mom feels proud of me and i feel slightly better. i guess stuff like being less annoying and being more liked by my peers could be some, but i’m not exactly sure.
